lede.en: Every building has a different renter, market, and leasing story. We'd love to learn more about yours and see where USWOO can help.
lede.zh: 无论是新楼盘预租，还是现有物业的日常招租，我们都期待了解您的需求，一起探索更适合您物业的租赁与推广方案。

hey.en: To our developer and property management partners:
hey.zh: 致开发商及物业管理合作伙伴：

lede.en: Higher occupancy and more stable rental income, driving long-term growth in your property’s value.
lede.zh: 以更高的出租率、更稳健的租金收入，推动物业资产长期增值。

title.zh: 您的资产价值<br class=m-br>我们的共同目标

slogan.en: We care not only about how many units we lease, but also how quickly each unit is leased, helping properties shorten vacancy periods and maintain stable rental income.
slogan.zh: 我们不仅关注出租数量，也重视每套房源的出租速度，帮助物业缩短空置时间，保持稳定的租金收入。

title.zh: 减少空置<br class=m-br>让出租更高效

text.en: Reach high-intent renters through local communities, targeted marketing and diverse promotion channels, so every impression counts.
text.zh: 依托本地社群、精准营销与多元推广渠道，触达高意向租客，让每一次曝光更有价值。

text.en: From first inquiry to signed lease, we connect every step of the rental process to reduce drop-off and speed up leasing.
text.zh: 从首次咨询到最终签约，紧密衔接每个租赁环节，减少客户流失，加快出租进度。

text.en: Beyond short-term promotion, we keep growing your property’s presence among target renters, building steady demand for future leasing.
text.zh: 不止于短期推广，持续扩大物业在目标客群中的影响力，为未来租赁积累稳定需求。

desc.en: Higher-intent traffic helps shorten the path from interest to lease.
desc.zh: 我们不只带来看房和咨询，更关注最终的签约结果。通过有效沟通与及时跟进，让更多租房意向转化为实际租约。

desc.en: Over 60% of our inquiries come from organic search, social media, and word of mouth. Steady organic traffic keeps us connected to renters who are truly looking for a home.
desc.zh: 超过六成的咨询来自自然搜索、社交媒体及口碑推荐。稳定的自然流量，让我们能够持续接触真正有租房需求的客户。

desc.en: A broad distribution network across renter communities and platforms.
desc.zh: 广泛的社交媒体与社群推广网络，让我们能够针对不同物业和租客群体，扩大房源曝光，吸引更多关注。

desc.en: A significant share of renter demand comes through non-paid channels, so every lead arrives already interested in your building.
desc.zh: 多年来积累的客户信任与市场口碑，让不少租客在开始找房时就主动联系 USWOO，为合作物业带来持续的租赁机会。

text.en: On-the-ground knowledge of the markets and buildings we work with.
text.zh: 长期深耕纽约租赁市场，熟悉不同社区的租赁趋势、租客偏好及物业特点，能够结合市场变化与实际需求，提供更有针对性的建议。

text.en: A closer understanding of how international renters search, compare, and decide.
text.zh: 了解国际租客在语言、文化及租房习惯上的差异，帮助他们更清楚地理解房源信息、申请要求和租赁流程，减少沟通中的误解。

text.en: Real people supporting the leasing journey, not just sending traffic.
text.zh: 从初次咨询、预约看房到申请及入住协调，我们重视每一个服务细节，及时回应租客需求，也积极配合物业团队的日常工作。

text.en: We value lasting partnerships over one-off campaigns.
text.zh: 我们重视每一次合作，也珍惜长期建立的信任。通过持续沟通、市场反馈与灵活配合，与物业团队共同应对不断变化的租赁需求。

lede.en: International renters often make housing decisions differently. Timing, communication, cultural context, and trust all play a role. Our team understands those details and helps turn that understanding into a smoother leasing experience for both renters and properties.
lede.zh: 好的租赁合作，不只是把房子租出去。我们熟悉纽约不同社区的租赁市场，也了解国际租客的生活习惯、沟通方式和实际需求。从日常沟通到租赁协调，我们希望让物业管理更省心，也让租客的整个租房过程更顺畅。

title.en: We understand the renter behind the lead.
title.zh: 熟悉纽约市场<br class=m-br>更了解租客的需求

description.en: We care not only about how many units we lease, but also how quickly each unit is leased, helping properties shorten vacancy periods and maintain stable rental income.
description.zh: 我们不仅关注出租数量，也重视每套房源的出租速度，帮助物业缩短空置时间，保持稳定的租金收入。
